Job Title 
 Assistant Professor of Petroleum Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) 
 
 Agency 
Texas A&M International University 
 
 Department 
School Of Engineering 
 
 Proposed Minimum Salary 
 Commensurate 
 
 Job Location 
 Laredo, Texas 
 
 Job Type 
 Faculty 
 
 Job Description 
 Texas A&M International University (TAMIU), a member of The Texas A&M University System, welcomes applicants for the position of Assistant Professor of Petroleum Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) to begin Fall 2027 .
  
 TAMIU is a Hispanic-Serving Institution with over 8,000 students, located in Laredo, Texas, a vibrant and bicultural city with a population of about 250,000. The University advances knowledge through research and discovery, teaching and learning, community engagement, and public service, with an intentional focus on student success and research excellence. For more information, please visit https://www.tamiu.edu/. 
  
 This is a tenure-track, nine-month Assistant Professor of Petroleum Engineering position. A reduced teaching load supports research development. Primary duties will include establishing an independent, externally funded research program at the intersection of artificial intelligence and petroleum engineering; contributing to the BS in Petroleum Engineering by designing and teaching AI-related petroleum engineering coursework; and mentoring student research and senior design projects. The successful candidate will also contribute to the AI-themed MS in Systems Engineering. Duties also include teaching Petroleum Engineering and engineering courses as needed; supporting recruitment, accreditation, curriculum development, and School service; and collaborating with academic, industry, and government partners on interdisciplinary research. This position requires face-to-face interactions through a regular schedule of attendance on campus and in the workplace.
  
 The School of Engineering offers ABET-accredited programs in Systems, Computer, and Petroleum Engineering. Its BS in Computer Science and MS in Systems Engineering launched in 2026, and its BS in Civil Engineering launches in 2027. This position will expand Petroleum Engineering faculty capacity to meet significant enrollment growth. This position is part of a strategic faculty expansion in the School of Engineering to hire 10 permanent faculty members, eight tenure-track and two instructional, beginning Fall 2027.
  
 Required Qualifications 
  
 The successful candidate must hold a Ph.D. in Petroleum Engineering or a closely related discipline by the appointment start date. Applicants nearing completion may be considered if the degree is awarded before appointment. Candidates must demonstrate expertise at the intersection of artificial intelligence and petroleum engineering through research, scholarship, professional experience, or a combination thereof; be able to design and teach AI-related petroleum engineering coursework; mentor student research; and establish an independent research program in this area. Areas of particular interest include emerging applications of artificial intelligence in petroleum engineering, such as physics-informed AI and hybrid modeling; digital twins; generative AI; AI-enabled reservoir, drilling, or production optimization; and intelligent and autonomous systems. Experience or demonstrated ability to pursue externally funded research and collaborate with industry is especially desirable.
  
 We offer competitive salaries and a benefits package including health insurance, retirement benefits, and life insurance. Additional pay is available for summer teaching. Financial support for professional development opportunities, such as attending academic conferences, is also provided. Moving expenses are covered in whole or in part by the University.
  

 Application Process 

 The completed employment application must include: 

 A letter of interest or cover letter that addresses the candidate’s qualifications for the position.
 Current curriculum vitae.
 Unofficial transcripts documenting the conferred degree or progress toward completion of the required doctorate.
 Names and contact information of three current professional references. 
 Statement of research interests, experience, and future plans.
 Statement of teaching experience and philosophy.
  
 Applications must be submitted online at https://www.tamiu.edu/admins/ohr/employment/. Review of applications will begin on October 31, 2026, and continue until the position is filled.

 INSTRUCTIONS TO APPLICANT : During the application process, you have only one opportunity to enter the requested information, upload documents, and submit the application. You will not be able to make changes or add additional documents once you “Submit” the application materials. The software does not allow you to “Save” your application and return to complete the process at a later time. The page "My Experience" has an area provided under Resume/CV to drop or upload files. 

 Applications received by Texas A&M International University must have all job application data entered. Failure to provide all job application data could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. “See resume” is not an acceptable entry in the job application. 
 
 All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.
 
 Equal Opportunity/Veterans/Disability Employer.
